text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-01, 1 Inch Stainless Steel True Square Cabinet Knob

The sleek, clean lines of the Heidegger square cabinet knob make it perfect for modern homes; and the brushed stainless steel finish means it will match stainless steel appliances. The unexpected modern cube shape is an excellent way to add chicness to any cabinet door or drawer.

Also available: Matching Stainless Steel Square Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Heidegger Stainless Steel Square Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 1" Square
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 square knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
